test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 27 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements is/are correct regarding the atomic number of an element?

Statement I: The atomic number of an element represents the number of protons present in the nucleus of an atom.

Statement II: The atomic number of an element represents the number of neutrons present in the nucleus of an atom.

options.text: Neither statement I nor II is correct.
Both statements I and II are correct.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Only statement I is correct**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Atomic number** is a fundamental property of an element that determines its identity.
 
• Statement I is correct because the **atomic number** of an element represents the number of **protons** present in the nucleus of an atom.
